description: Fits other extensions' popups to the popup RemBrowse shows them in.

functions.name: start
functions.description: Starts watching for extension popups in the extension process.

events.name: onPopupSize
events.description: A popup written for desktop Firefox reported the size its content wants, in CSS pixels.

viewportWidth.description: The width of the viewport the popup was laid out in. Left out for a popup with a viewport tag of its own.

viewportHeight.description: The height of the viewport the popup was laid out in, which can be more than the popup's own height. Left out for a popup with a viewport tag of its own.
